   105	    def composed_applications(self, entry):
   106	        """Every transitive filter application bound to entry parameters."""
   107	        applications = []
   108	        seen = set()
   109	        stack = []
   110	        for pipe in self.pipes_by_target.get(entry, ()):
   111	            mapping = dict(pipe.bind)
   112	            key = (pipe.filter, tuple(sorted(mapping.items())))
   113	            if key in seen:
   114	                continue
   115	            seen.add(key)
   116	            applications.append((pipe.filter, mapping))
   117	            stack.append((pipe.filter, mapping))
   118	        while stack:
   119	            name, mapping = stack.pop()
   120	            for pipe in self.pipes_by_target.get(name, ()):
   121	                composed = {}
   122	                for fparam, tparam in pipe.bind.items():
   123	                    source = mapping.get(tparam)
   124	                    if source is None:
   125	                        raise InvalidCampaign("unbound filter parameter")
   126	                    composed[fparam] = source
   127	                key = (pipe.filter, tuple(sorted(composed.items())))
   128	                if key in seen:
   129	                    continue
   130	                seen.add(key)
   131	                applications.append((pipe.filter, composed))
   132	                stack.append((pipe.filter, composed))
   133	        return applications

   135	    def type_declarations(self, order, modules):
   136	        """Enum, struct and alias names, dependency before user, once each."""
   137	        emitted = []
   138	        visited = set()
   139	
   140	        def visit(type):
   141	            name = type.decl
   142	            if name is None or name in visited:
   143	                return
   144	            visited.add(name)
   145	            if isinstance(type, Alias):
   146	                visit(type.type)
   147	                emitted.append(name)
   148	            elif isinstance(type, Struct):
   149	                for field in type.fields.values():
   150	                    visit(field)
   151	                emitted.append(name)
   152	            elif isinstance(type, Enum):
   153	                emitted.append(name)
   154	            elif isinstance(type, Array):
   155	                visit(type.element_type)
   156	
   157	        for name in order:
   158	            module = modules[name]
   159	            for _, type in module.params:
   160	                visit(type)
   161	            visit(module.result[1])
   162	        return emitted
